Alongside my academic research, I undertake commissioned research and advisory work for international organisations, governments, and civil society. This work generally addresses the same questions as my scholarship: what the IMF asks of the countries it lends to, how fiscal adjustment affects social protection and health, and how the international financial institutions are responding to climate change. The reports are freely available below.

## Policy reports

```{r}
#| output: asis
pub_list("policy-reports", heading = "h3")
```
